name: Pure Country TB
sire: By LIAM'S MAP (2011). 6 wins, $1,358,940, Breeders' Cup Dirt Mile [G1]-NTR. [G1]), BURNHAM SQUARE ($2,884,244 [G1]), NAPOLEON SOLO ($2,010,520 [G1]), COLONEL LIAM ($1,812,565, Turf Classic S. [G1]), CRAZY BEAUTIFUL ($1,182,240 [G2]).
